description.zh: Claude Code 风格米白/暖黑主题。跟随系统深浅色自动切换、透明输入框。新对话空状态显示 Claude 星芒与问候语，星芒和标语各有独立开关，发出第一条消息后自动淡出。问候语按星期与时段确定，并依据本地使用习惯（深夜居多时显示夜猫子），习惯数据仅保存在本机、上限 1MB、按最久未见淘汰，不调用任何模型。适配 Operit 1.12.2。
description.en: Claude Code inspired theme for Operit 1.12.2: paper light and warm dark palettes, system dark-mode following, transparent chat input. Empty chats show the Claude starburst and a greeting chosen by weekday and time of day, with separate switches for the icon and the slogan; both fade out after the first message. Habits are counted locally only (1 MB cap, least-recently-seen eviction) and never sent to a model.
